scope: native v2 stock Show catalogue, native-versus-converted comparison harness, and the chapter Marker role with its Gallery/reading-card/Live/pilot projections
invariants: Chapter is the only enumerated Marker role; an unknown role is a codec refusal, never a silently stripped field.
The role owns no time partition or execution trigger: compile recipe, generated source, compile summary and runtime state are identical with and without it.
Conversion marks every former Scene label as a chapter at its original global start; no Scene label mints a duplicate guide.
Absorption preserves the authored Marker's identity, time, name and colour and promotes only its role, and its source leaves stay accounted.
A Marker that differs in name or time from a Scene label stays general-purpose; the general Marker owner never authors or clears a role.
Chapter projection filters on role, then orders by (timeMs, id) with the Marker owner's exact UTF-16 tie-break; equal-time chapters stay distinct entries.
A time with no started chapter projects no chapter; no label is ever synthesized, and a chapter span never runs past Show End.
Every native v2 stock record validates, reopens through the v2 codec unchanged and compiles with no converter in the path.
The native catalogue lists the same Shows, in the same order, with the same names, Zones, Layout definitions and output contracts as the pinned legacy catalogue.
The pinned legacy v1 builder is independent of the native builder, so the comparison is native output versus converted pinned legacy rather than two outputs of one builder.
Every native/converted representation difference carries an explicit classification; nothing is allowlisted, and any runtime divergence at matched global times fails the report.
Native resource ledgers match the legacy compile except the three Zone Layout showcases whose silent runtime use #1036 retired; that set is pinned by name.
partitions: no chapter / converted Scene label / absorbed same-name-and-time Marker / same-time differently-named general Marker / equal-time chapters / dormant chapter beyond Show End
chapter lookup before the first start, at an exact start, inside a span, and at an equal-time tie
Marker intents: add with a role (refused), move, update name, update colour, remove, and each applied to a chapter and to a general Marker

stock catalogue families: Learn 100/200/300, Effects and compositing showcases, Transition and easing references, Aperture references, Zone Layout showcases, the installation Stage, and the three remixes

native record features: single and multiple Zones, explicit overlay Layers, Layer-participant and whole-output Transitions, boundary-owned scalar ramps, repeated and transferred Layout occurrences, Group definition with two occurrences, stepped and offset instance clocks, deterministic-loop and continuous lifecycles
comparison classifications: identical representation, volatile record stamp, unclassified (fails)
sequences: convert a multi-Scene v1 Show -> project chapters -> serialize and reopen the v2 record -> project again
convert with a pre-existing same-name/time Marker and a same-time general Marker -> assert absorption, identity, colour and the untouched general Marker
move a chapter -> rename it -> rename a general Marker -> assert the roles and the projection after each step
build every native stock record -> validate -> serialize/reopen -> prepare -> compile -> compare resources against the legacy compile
build every native stock record -> convert the pinned legacy record -> compare representation, recipe, source, summary, and Fast/Precise output, state and lifecycle at matched global times

pilot route: open a converted three-Scene Show -> read the chapter projection -> rename the absorbed chapter -> add a general Marker -> reload saved v2 bytes -> re-read the projection and the stored roles
oracles: Chapter projection output and index lookup, asserted as complete literal values rather than counts.
Reopened provisional v2 codec bytes and a reopened v2 .pxlshow bundle, both carrying the role exactly.
Compiled artifact code for the same record with and without the role, asserted equal.
prepareShowV2ForCompile + compileShow on each native record: ready status, nonempty code, and no resource blockers.
compileShowForArtifact on each pinned legacy record: resource ledger compared field for field against the native compile.

docs/plans/show-v2-native-parity-report.json: per-Show representation, classification, recipe/source/summary equality and RuntimeParity in both fidelities, verified byte-for-byte against the committed report.
docs/plans/show-v2-parity-report.json: the 47-record legacy report, unchanged apart from its recorded provisional schema hash.
The real pilot route through repository Playwright: rendered chapter list text, stored v2 roles read back from /api/shows, and zero horizontal overflow at 390px.
Committed browser captures of the Gallery band, the public reading card and the pilot Marker panel, opened and inspected.
redEvidence: showChaptersV2 module absent: the whole chapter suite failed to import (13 cases).
Converted Scene labels carried no role: 2 chapter cases failed against the pinned projection.
Absorption left the authored Marker general: the identity/colour case failed and conversion accounting reported four unaccounted marker leaves.
The v2 schema admitted no role: parse of a chapter-bearing record refused until the enum landed.
galleryShowChapters absent: the Gallery projection cases failed to import.
show-v2-native-parity report absent: the comparison script had no committed report to verify against.
faults: Converter omits the role on a new Scene-label Marker -> 2 chapter cases fail (converted arc, general-Marker isolation).
Converter absorption does not promote the role -> the identity/colour absorption case fails.
Projection drops the role filter -> 6 cases fail, including the general-Marker and .pxlshow cases.
Projection orders by time only -> the equal-time selectable-entries case fails.
Projection does not clamp a span to Show End -> the dormant-chapter case fails.
Index lookup returns the first rather than the last equal-time chapter -> the exact-start selection case fails.
Schema widens role to any string -> the codec refusal case fails.
Native learn101 Clip duration changed by 1s -> the record-equality case, the resource census case and the native parity report's unclassified-difference guard all fail.
Same mutation with every difference force-classified -> the native parity report's runtime guard fails independently at fast@9999 and precise@9999.
residualGaps: The chapter role is authored by conversion or by a native record only; no edit owner or route creates one, by design until a product decision assigns that surface.
The Live caption's per-frame text is driven by the rAF loop, so its content is proven by the browser captures and by showChapterIndexAtV2's unit cases rather than by a jsdom assertion.
Production playback, compilation and Gallery keyframes still read the pinned legacy v1 records; #1039 owns activation.
The three Zone Layout showcases census differently from v1 under the accepted #1036 silent-runtime retirement; the difference is measured in the 47-record report, not re-derived here.
Feature Guide chapter wording is prepared but unpublished: production reference claims land with #1039.

Both stock catalogues ship in the production bundle until #1042 deletes the legacy builder: measured 122.6 kB minified / 18.2 kB gzipped, the deliberate price of naming chapters from role rather than from Scene labels.
